Consistent Training via Energy-Based GFlowNets for

title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote:
Consistent Training via Energy-Based GFlowNets for
Modeling Discrete Joint Distributions

extractions.description: The paper introduces Joint Energy-Based GFlowNets (JEB-GFN), an extension of Energy-Based GFlowNets for modeling joint distributions over multiple variables. It demonstrates that JEB-GFN can learn the joint distribution over two variables, data x and its corresponding label y, and leverage it for conditional generation. The paper evaluates JEB-GFN for generating peptides with anti-microbial properties in a single round as well as active learning setting.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on a new method, JEB-GFN, and its application to antimicrobial peptide generation. While this could have implications for health (SDG3), it isn't a central theme. Other SDGs are not directly addressed.
